comments.content: Missing `break;` after the `priority` case causes fall-through into the `tileVisible` case. When a guide specifies `priority=...`, `attributeMatcher.group("valueString")` will be null (since the int alternative matched), and `Boolean.parseBoolean(null)` returns false, silently setting `tileVisible` to `false` on every guide that has a priority. This will then trigger the new `Context` check ("Invisible tiles should be pinned or have an explicit priority") for guides that have a priority but no explicit `tileVisible`, breaking the build. Add `break;` after `guide.setPriority(...)`.
